title: Restore web Playwright baseline shared harness regressions
intent: Diagnose the broad web Playwright baseline failure pattern and repair shared setup/harness/app regressions until the full web Playwright suite is green.
observed_behavior: A representative dashboard + environments slice initially failed across unrelated areas.
Public ContextVM commands were built as kind 25910 but shared result subscriptions only listened for encrypted wrapper kinds, leaving modal submissions unresolved.
Several E2E harnesses used an invalid repeated-b service pubkey that modern secp/NIP-44 validation rejects.
Dashboard payment result events were emitted before the shared result subscription existed and bypassed mock relay normalization.
Generated Playwright report/test-result artifacts were tracked in git.
The final baseline had four failures: deployment-history rollback dialog, deployment run logs, policy delete tombstone in full-suite context, and relay-backed DNS hydration.
intended_behavior: Public ContextVM kind 25910 requests resolve from scoped kind 25910 result subscriptions with #p/#e correlation and OK verification preserved.
Encrypted flows continue to use gift-wrapped 1059 unless a public control-plane caller explicitly selects kind 25910.
E2E harness service pubkeys are valid hex secp256k1 public keys.
Harness result delivery is event-driven through mock relay EVENT delivery; no sleep-based waits are introduced.
Generated Playwright artifacts are removed from git and ignored.
Full npm run test:e2e completes with 0 failures, preserving only the existing intentional skip.
